reading_hypothesis: A prefix may own a terminal ID before its red-black character siblings. Keep Here outside the balanced sibling tree, so empty-string behavior is direct and less/same/more retains the successful unbalanced traversal shape. Balancing moves character plus same/tail subtree together without introducing a Letter datatype.
representation: Trie = Vacant | Here{id,more} | Fork{color,char,less,same,more}; Here can occur only at each prefix root and its more is a sibling tree.
invariants: Each prefix root is an optional Here followed by Vacant or a black Fork.
Here never appears on a less/more sibling edge.
Red sibling Forks have black children.
Sibling paths have equal black height and strictly ordered U32 character codes.
Each same child is a complete independently blackened prefix Trie.
Terminal state is separate from every U32 character code, including zero.
risks: All state invariants need independent additive validation; existing package laws retain their existing proof boundary.
Performance and representation documentation still require coordinator review.
fixed_inputs: Original non-main Bend sources copied unchanged.
